rationale: David brings deep production robotics expertise from shipping autonomous systems at Skycatch and Agtonomy, while Nico is actively building autonomous mobile robots and manipulation systems at Lucé Robotics. David's conviction that real-time infrastructure is foundational for production robotics, combined with his mentor experience in scaling robotics software teams and computer vision for autonomous systems, directly complements Nico's hands-on roboticist work—particularly useful as Lucé scales from prototype toward production.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Nico — you're both shipping robotics systems and could benefit from each other's perspective on the production robotics stack, from autonomous mobility to real-time infrastructure.
